- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cancer is a water sign and is known for its emotional and intuitive nature.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] People born under the sign of Cancer are generally nurturing, caring, and protective of those they love.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cancers are known for their strong memories and their ability to hold on to the past, both good and bad.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cancers tend to be sensitive and compassionate.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cancers are often described as being "motherly."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cancers can be moody and may have a tendency to retreat into their shell when feeling hurt or vulnerable.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, Cancer is a complex and deeply emotional sign known for its strong relationships and love of home and family.
